name: revised-down
about: §4R L2: Meta revised yesterday's numbers down overnight; the fold holds only the revised figures, which are smaller than the first report.

output.headline: On November 2, 2026, 1 campaign ran, spending $110.90 for 2 leads at $55.45 per lead.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet spent $110.90 on 6,015 impressions and 70 clicks, a 1.2% click rate, and brought in 2 leads at $55.45 per lead.
Spend so far in 2026-11 is $198.00 on Meta, with 29 days left in the month.
The 2026-09-28 cohort had 40 leads: 36 contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied and 5 hired. Its hire rate was 12.5%, and 9 applications ended without a hire.
The 2026-09-21 cohort had 38 leads: 33 contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied and 4 hired. Its hire rate was 10.5%, a bit lower than the next week's, and 8 applications ended without a hire.
Recruiters marked none of the leads in either mature cohort as qualified, and closed none as not qualified, so those stages may not be getting recorded.
The 2026-10-26 cohort is too young to judge: so far it has 12 leads, 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied and no hires yet. The sheet has no lead-quality figures from calls for the last 14 days.
